description:
Check now

Runs a check of a monitor right away, for all its resources or only the listed ones. Answers 202 with the queued check; poll getCheck with its id until status is done or failed, then read results. Costs the API's credits per resource.

resourceIds.description: Check only these resources of the monitor; omit for all of them.

name: hasdata_monitoring_monitors_runCheck
title: monitoring_monitors: POST /monitors/{id}/check
